title: Authorize public Stalheart repository and separate rocket-planet handoff
context: The owner explicitly requested initialization, commit, push and a public playable page, plus a small note for a separate rocket-landing experiment on the same planet.
outcome: Existing Git history is retained. Created public kai-denrei/stalheart, configured origin and GitHub Pages, and added a pinned Actions workflow that tests/checks/builds before deploying dist. Ignored private Deban records, local working presets and captures are excluded. docs/ROCKET-PLANET.md records the main seed, pinned grid/dungeon recipe, unit sphere, scale conversion, rendering identity and flight integration boundaries. The rocket game itself is a separate future experiment, not integrated into this snapshot.
evidence: npm test, npm run check, npm run build and npm run test:browser passed locally; targeted Sniper and Sinkhole source acceptance passed
